propositions: Minor release 0.12.0 requires synchronized version bumps across pyproject.toml, server.json (top-level and packages[]), and uv.lock with preflight guard validation and full test suite passing
CHANGELOG.md pre-existing defect (duplicate [Unreleased] headers) must be consolidated into a single curated [0.12.0] - 2026-08-15 section with fresh [Unreleased] and corrected compare links

Release workflow dispatch from main requires Gerrit review approval (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, no unresolved comments) followed by GitHub Actions job completion and pypi environment deployment approval before PyPI publication
Multi-channel verification across PyPI, GitHub Release/tag, MCP Registry, Homebrew tap, and PEP 740 attestation must confirm 0.12.0 availability before acceptance
All acceptance criteria (build, lint, typecheck, tests, twine check, smoke probe) must pass; any pre-publish failure halts release; post-publish failures require yank and fixed patch version
